script:
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$OFF" --quiet --check agent.condenser.kind eq LLMSummarizingCondenser
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$OFF/condense" --expect 500 --check error_id exists --timeout 120 --save F10.condense-llm-failure/condense
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$OFF/events/count" --query kind=$CREQ --check . eq 1
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$OFF/events/count" --query kind=$COND --check . eq 0
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$OFF" --quiet --check execution_status eq idle
